choices.facts: Some pedestal and consumable rewards are mutually exclusive: collecting one removes alternatives. An active item can replace the current active slot. Treat prices, options groups and multiple pedestals as choices, not routine pickups.

hearts.facts: Red hearts refill red containers; soul and black hearts are a separate buffer and are usually lost before red health. An eternal heart can become a container on the next floor, so its timing can matter. Blood donation spends red health first: do not confuse a soul-heart buffer with spare donation health.

shop.facts: Shops sell resources and items for coins and commonly consume a key to enter; Repentance first-floor shops start unlocked. Compare observed prices with actual coins and reserve keys for unopened important rooms. Unseen stock and future payouts are unknown.

blind.facts: Curse of the Blind hides pedestal identities. Alt-path treasure rooms can include a hidden item alternative. Do not treat a hidden or unidentified choice as a known safe stat upgrade.

haemolacria.facts: Haemolacria fires arcing tears that burst on impact; fire rate and range are reduced. Treat linear shot predictions cautiously and reposition when impacts miss. Ordinary Haemolacria bursts are tears, not automatically player-damaging explosions. Ipecac or bomb synergies change that assumption.

ipecac.facts: Ipecac produces arcing explosive shots that can injure Isaac. High damage does not remove the need for blast clearance. A short-range or multi-directional synergy can make self-hits more likely; the executor does not model all explosive weapon combinations.

contact.facts: Mom's Heels grants range and contact damage in Repentance, but contact damage does not itself grant contact immunity. Keep avoiding enemies rather than deliberately body-blocking them.

build_risk.facts: Cursed Eye may teleport the player when hit while charging; Missing No. rerolls the passive build. A free passive item can therefore change controls or invalidate a build. Unknown effects and unfamiliar weapon replacements need deliberate evaluation.
